name: Context menu designer
author: Brett
description: Design context menus: create, edit, name, rename and save them, and make 'chunks' (reusable pieces of a menu, saved from any menu with Save as chunk) that you insert into menus by name; chunks can hold items, separators and other chunks. Every menu and chunk carries its own style (font, size, weight, style, text / background colour, hover text / background colour); a chunk inherits the menu's style or uses its own. A floating live preview re-renders on every change. A saved menu becomes a standard context-menu asset (ctxd-<id>) you pick in Appearance or with Use as the context menu. Designs are kept on the console server (0600).
